name: Blake
source:
Despite his shorter stature, Blake has no issues knocking his opponents out of the way and playing long periods. However, he is notoriously hard to work with thanks to his abrasive personality and undisciplined style. Paige is the first person to accept working with him as a defensive partner without incentive.
